flow: wire-first (REST multipart POST /apiv2-files/file/upload with Bearer access_token) with composer-attach UI fallback

rpc.method: REST multipart: POST /apiv2-files/file/upload (baseURL '/apiv2-files', data: formData, method 'POST', timeout 0, responseType 'text') — returns the uploaded file id; lightweight same-origin sibling POST /file/upload_simple. Proto mirror: kimi.gateway.file.v1.FileService.Upload (client-streaming). Parse tracking: kimi.gateway.file.v1.FileService.GetFileParseProgress + kimi.gateway.chat.v1.ChatService.ListChatFiles.
rpc.auth: Authorization: Bearer <localStorage access_token> plus x-msh-version (2.2.0) / x-msh-platform / x-msh-device-id / x-msh-session-id / X-Traffic-Id / R-Timezone; x-msh-shield-data (TrustDecision blackbox from window._fmOpt.getinfo()) is OPTIONAL on the request — page-injected, may be required once abuse signals appear. Do NOT fabricate it; read it off the page if a request fails auth.
rpc.response: text response carrying the uploaded file id; FileMeta/FileBlob structured fields on the proto side; image blobs served from https://kimi-img.moonshot.cn
rpc.errors: parse failures assert REASON_KIMI_FILE_PARSE_JOB_FAIL / REASON_KIMI_FILE_MODERATION_FAIL — surface these to the caller as file-specific, not chat errors

steps.note: session snapshot injected (data/www.kimi.com/.session) — localStorage access_token replay as Bearer; no cookies involved

page-side fetch with formData (field name TBD — capture on first live run), responseType 'text', Bearer + x-msh-* headers; returns file id. Multiple files: repeat or use FileService.Upload client-streaming once frame layout is captured.

kimi.gateway.file.v1.FileService.GetFileParseProgress + ChatService.ListChatFiles confirm the file parsed and is bound to the chat; REASON_KIMI_FILE_PARSE_JOB_FAIL / REASON_KIMI_FILE_MODERATION_FAIL mean the turn must not be sent
if the wire envelope is rejected (auth/shield gates): composer attach UI via input[type=file] — CANDIDATE selector only, Attach UI DOM unverified; drive the site's own picker on first live capture

known: REST endpoint+method+formData+responseType grounded from the JS-bundle inventory (kimi CAPABILITIES.md §3); exact multipart field name, response envelope, and the composer attach DOM are UNVERIFIED until first live capture. The UI path (step 4) currently lacks a verified selector — prefer wire.
stealth: real session (localStorage access_token), page-side fetch (same fetch stack the SPA uses), no synthetic input events; TrustDecision (x-msh-shield-data) + VolcanoEngine remain active on the page
